alert.pending: Crop targets → dose controller: proposal #{id} for {crop} ({stage}) would change {count} controller setting(s). Review it on Crop & Nutrition — nothing changes until an admin or operator approves it.
alert.approved: Crop-target proposal #{id} for {crop} approved by {by}: it applies at the start of the next dose cycle.
alert.rejected: Crop-target proposal #{id} for {crop} rejected by {by}: the dose controller keeps its settings.
alert.applied: Crop-target proposal #{id} for {crop} applied at the start of a dose cycle.
alert.cancelled: {crop}: the dose controller link was switched to manual; open proposals were cancelled.
alert.matches: {crop}: the dose controller already matches the crop targets.
alert.apply_failed: Crop-target proposal #{id} was NOT applied, the dose controller is unchanged: {reason}
